description: exp10 + a trainable exponential output transform on the actor mean: mean -> c + exp(mean / t), with c a free trainable scalar and t a trainable scalar constrained positive via softplus. Everything else identical to exp10.
init_rationale: c=-1, t=1 makes the transform a first-order match to the identity at init (c+exp(0)=0, slope 1/t=1), so exp16 starts behaviourally identical to exp10; verified to 7.6e-5 on the action mean.
